name: coding-delegation
description: Agent-agnostic coding handoff with an opt-in model tier catalog. Tool order comes from each user's answers.

tool_claude.title: You pay for Claude Code
tool_claude.description: Enable Claude Code for model routing.

tool_codex.title: You pay for Codex CLI
tool_codex.description: Enable Codex CLI for model routing.

plan_claude.title: Claude Code plan
plan_claude.description: included is covered by the subscription. extra bills more and is skipped unless you allow extra spend.

plan_codex.title: Codex plan
plan_codex.description: included is covered by the subscription. extra bills more and is skipped unless you allow extra spend.

plan_cursor.title: Cursor plan
plan_cursor.description: included is covered by the subscription. extra bills more and is skipped unless you allow extra spend.

first_tool.title: Preferred first tool
first_tool.description: Used only as your tie-break. No tool is preferred until you choose.

frontier.title: Frontier models
frontier.description: Frontier stays off unless you allow it.

extra_spend.title: Extra spend
extra_spend.description: Nothing that bills extra is routed unless this allows it.

extra_spend_cap.title: Extra-spend cap
extra_spend_cap.description: Used only when extra spend is capped. Zero allows no extra spend.

on_limit_or_stall.title: Limit or stall
on_limit_or_stall.description: What to do when a job hits a limit, an error, or your stall timeout.

stall_timeout.title: Stall timeout
stall_timeout.description: Minutes with no progress before a stall fallback.

versions.title: Model versions
versions.description: newest resolves each family to the newest listed model. pin uses the pins field.

pins.title: Pinned models
pins.description: Only when versions is pin. Space-separated family=model pairs, such as sol=gpt-6-sol.
